selection_rule: Reservoir random 3 distinct from every complete, result-verifiable 5-9car 2025-26H1 market; actual finishes NEVER used for selection or stake estimation.

research_protocol.probabilities: Historical 2021-2024 realized ranks vs market-normalized implied rank triplet frequency, shrink expected count 25; probabilities renormalized per race
research_protocol.formation: Search all 1..4-car slot subsets with product slot sizes<=18, keep 2..12 actual ordered tickets, no predetermined line/template; rank first7? NO, use actual car sets.
research_protocol.candidate: Highest estimated net cash expected value after optimizing selected geometry, before any result is observed
research_protocol.staking: Mutually-exclusive multi-ticket Kelly log-growth optimization with 2% TOTAL bankroll exposure cap; 100yen rounding; max risk bankroll example 100,000yen, 0 stake allowed.
research_protocol.market_safety: Only tickets with model p*odds >1.025 allowed inside a bet; if no positive rounded-size set, skip.
research_protocol.model_is_unvalidated: In-sample calibrator with final odds, prior studies have inspected later periods; no guarantee of profit or real-world availability.
research_protocol.not_modified: No live buy rules, predictor, or websites modified.
